caption: The drawing features a rectangular decorative design with intricate symmetrical patterns. Along the left edge, there is a vertical border containing repeating motifs of blue-and-pink flowers with yellow centers, connected by red, yellow, and blue curving lines creating a lattice effect. The main section includes a series of stylized floral and leaf shapes, primarily in red, blue, yellow, pink, and light purple, outlined in dark gray or black. The background behind the designs alternates between light gray and yellow sections, with additional curved lines and petal-like forms in pastel blue and pink. The drawing is framed by a thin dark border. Below the composition, the text "Buckskin Nss Binding" is written in cursive script, and the number "28" is present in the bottom left corner.
title: Plate 48: Buckskin Design: From Portfolio "Spanish Colonial Designs of New Mexico"
